title: Auto End Spatial Final States
description: Make sure that all final states in the spatial interactions automatically end the interaction and no finalize is necessary.
summary: Made spatial interaction runtime treat any declared final state as terminal, auto-run commit when an event transitions from a committable state into a final state, and added coverage for confirm-to-final auto-commit behavior. Verified with core tests, Stately adapter tests, and a direct debug runtime probe.
